scientific_integrity: Finite exact enumeration of labelled graph states and two move graphs; two independent implementations with full state/transition certificate. The known scalar decycling number is credited. No general-family statement or external independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: No claim for larger generalized Petersen graphs or other move rules; possible equivalent unpublished or unindexed work, and the full Gao et al. (2015) article was not accessible for comparison.
title: Two move regimes for optimal decycling sets of the Möbius–Kantor graph
